judgments.supporting_quote: Frame or ventilation openings may be full of dirt and prevent proper ventilation of motor --- CELL --- Open vent holes and check for a continuous stream of air from the motor.

Coat rotor shaft, tapered installation sleeve, and O-ring in the inside diameter of cartridge seal sleeve with a generous amount of P-80® or equivalent.
